# Thorbjørn Bonvik

> Personal site of Thorbjørn Bonvik, an independent iOS developer and musician in Oslo. It describes the apps, most fully Overdubber, a looper and multitrack recorder for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Overdubber in brief:

- Interface languages: English, Arabic, Danish, French, German, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu and Vietnamese.

- Records vocals and instruments in layers: record a part, listen back while adding the next.
- Free: up to eight layers per project, metronome and count-in, looping, non-destructive trim, timing and fades, volume, pan and mute per layer, optional tape warmth recorded into the take, reverb and Glue compression on the mix, WAV or M4A mix export, and Session video recording on iPhone and iPad.
- One-time purchase: unlimited layers, audio import, individual-track export (WAV files in a ZIP), more themes, and no ads on iPhone and iPad (the Mac version has no ads). No subscription and no account.
- Requires iOS or iPadOS 17 or later, or macOS 14 or later.
- On iPhone and iPad, supports VoiceOver (Magic Tap starts and stops a take) and larger text. Reduce Motion is respected on every platform.
- An audio recorder, not a full digital audio workstation: no MIDI, virtual instruments or plug-in hosting.
- Not connected to OverDubber, the delay effect plug-in for desktop music software.

## Gorilla Habits

A weekly habit tracker for iPhone and iPad. Chosen rest days preserve streaks and completion rates. Track up to five habits free and check in with a Home Screen widget. One-time Premium adds unlimited habits, full saved history, more widgets and optional private iCloud sync.

- [Gorilla Habits · English](https://thorbjxrn.github.io/gorilla-habits/)
- [Gorilla Habits · Français](https://thorbjxrn.github.io/gorilla-habits/fr/)
- [Gorilla Habits · 日本語](https://thorbjxrn.github.io/gorilla-habits/ja/)
- [Gorilla Habits · Español (México)](https://thorbjxrn.github.io/gorilla-habits/es-mx/)
- [Gorilla Habits · Português (Brasil)](https://thorbjxrn.github.io/gorilla-habits/pt-br/)

- [Building and Rebranding Gorilla Habits](https://thorbjxrn.github.io/blog/gorilla-habits/): Firsthand story of a SwiftUI habit tracker, the unpublished Habit Duck rebrand, six branding concepts, the NOK 700 advertising screen and its limitations, and the Gorilla Habits release.
- [Gorilla Habits on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6762311878?pt=128788989&ct=thorbjxrn.github.io&mt=8): Habit tracker with up to five habits free, ads, and optional one-time Premium. No subscription.
